title: Directional field kinematics: signed node/graph alignment and cross-scale coherence

target_design.cutoff_rule: target draw excluded; every state is computed from draws[:target_index] only

hypothesis: The signed cosine between each number's current six-feature velocity and acceleration, and between its graph-row velocity and acceleration, may preserve directional information lost by Q85 RMS acceleration. Node/graph coherence is the product of the two signed cosines per number.
selection: Select one directional operator by Discovery mean Top20 hits; tie-break lower mean actual rank then stable ID. Freeze before Validation and historical Blind OOS.

statistics.primary_gate: selected Blind OOS Top20 lift >=0.10 vs Equal42, paired 95% CI lower bound >0, paired Holm p<0.05, exact-null Holm p<0.05

exposure: Historical Blind OOS is already exposed to prior SONAR research; results are exploratory, not prospective confirmation.
safeguards: fixed alpha 0.20; no hyperparameter tuning on Validation or Blind OOS
zero vectors map to neutral cosine 0
all 40 node, graph and coherence directional values are persisted per target
rank replay and directional-vector replay are mandatory
no freeze modification, shadow insertion, engine promotion or automatic merge
Q86-DIR is distinct from the existing Q86 six-feature formula grammar branch
